stripped_test_modules: src/git/canonical.rs: inline `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` that builds storage fixtures
src/git/canonical/rules.rs: `#[cfg(test)] mod test` that imports the node storage and radicle-cob fixtures

src/git/canonical/symbolic.rs: inline order-dependent test module; its exact-order deserialization requires serde_json's preserve_order feature, which unifies globally and changes JSON map ordering across Kiln
shim_notes: src/lib.rs reproduces the crate root, the crypto re-export and the upstream `assert_matches` macro used by retained tests
src/git.rs re-exports radicle_oid::Oid and radicle_git_ref_format as fmt and carries the minimal `refs::branch` helper
src/git/raw.rs carries the git2 re-exports and the ErrorExt trait
src/identity.rs and src/identity/doc.rs carry the DID wrapper and the validated Delegates/Threshold types adapted from the upstream identity document
src/lib.rs defines an always-validating `refname!` because upstream's macro skips validation outside debug assertions, which the retained symbolic tests depend on

serde_json uses default features: preserve_order was removed because enabling it changes JSON map ordering for every crate in the workspace, and the symbolic-reference module is outside the canonical quorum path
excluded_upstream: The rest of the radicle crate is not imported: it links the `sqlite` crate, whose native sqlite3 link collides with the workspace's rusqlite/libsqlite3-sys
nonclaims: These digests identify the imported bytes only. They do not establish upstream review of this extraction, remote source authority, or that the shimmed module paths preserve every upstream behaviour outside canonical reference computation.
